Cosmetic Pets
are small magical creatures an adventurer can learn to summon.
Cosmetic Pets
can only perform the
Cosmetic Pet Attack
which deals almost no damage, and they quickly expire in combat when targeted by enemies. Only one
Cosmetic Pet
can be summoned at a time.
As of the 3 December 2023 update,
Cosmetic Pets
when summoned are persistent (until dismissed) even through zone transitions and logout/login.
Cosmetic Pets
are generally difficult to obtain. Many are distributed only during
Seasonal Events
in a particular year, while others are possible rewards for the completion of reoccurring events such as the
Crafting Caravan
. A few of the
Cosmetic Pets
such as the Kraken appear to be Admin-only items.
